items.name: clock-clock-24
items.title: ClockClock 24
items.description: An animated 24-clock grid that spells out the current time. Cycles through wave, spiral, scatter, and time-display phases. Self-contained colors — pass `bodyColor` and `handColor`; the panel, faces, rims, and dial shadows are all derived from them, with no CSS variables or theme setup required.

items.name: led-clock
items.title: LED Clock
items.description: A digital LED-style alarm clock with seven-segment HH:MM, blinking colon, and a side panel for month, date, and day of week. No theming hooks — fixed black panel with icy-blue segments and an off-white bezel.

items.name: keycap
items.title: Keycap
items.description: A tactile mechanical keycap with a randomizing pixel face and a synthesized thock on press. Customizable color and size; supports mouse, touch, and keyboard (Space / Enter).

items.name: perpetual-calendar
items.title: Perpetual Calendar
items.description: A tactile perpetual calendar board — embossed month, weekday, and date buttons rendered with pure CSS depth, with raised rings marking the current month, day, and date. Fully recolorable via color props and dependency-free.
